The site uses your browser language and an IP-based country lookup to choose regional content, a supported departure airport, language, and currency. It does not request GPS location. Your language and currency selections may be stored in your browser so they remain selected as you move between pages.
GoVeTrip respects user privacy and processes personal data only to deliver a relevant travel experience and improve our services.
We may collect information such as device type, browser language, country or city detection, search preferences, affiliate clicks, and contact details submitted through forms.
To personalize currency, language, and destination recommendations.
To improve site/app performance and user experience.
To review affiliate referrals and service performance.
To respond to inquiries and maintain compliance records.

Geolocation information helps us estimate the user country, city, and local travel context. The website may use browser locale information and a third-party IP location service to select regional content, nearby airports, language, and currency. When GPS is used, the browser asks for permission before location-sharing begins.

GoVeTrip stores language and currency preferences in your browser. The Travelpayouts flight widget is optional and is loaded only if you allow it in the cookie settings. This setting does not enable GoVeTrip click tracking. If you follow a booking link, the travel partner may use its own cookies and tracking under its privacy policy. GoVeTrip does not currently use analytics cookies.
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may request access, correction, or deletion of personal data, withdraw consent, or object to processing where applicable.
These terms govern the use of the GoVeTrip website and related services. By using the site, you agree to these conditions.

GoVeTrip provides travel discovery and comparison tools. It does not directly own or operate flight, hotel, or car rental inventory, and all booking transactions are completed through third-party partners.
We may earn a commission when users click through and book via linked offers. This affiliate relationship does not affect traveler pricing or service quality.
Travel offers, prices, and availability are subject to change without notice and should be verified with the provider or partner before booking.
Provide accurate trip information when searching.
Review partner terms before final booking or payment.
Ensure any booking changes or cancellations comply with partner policies.
GoVeTrip is not responsible for partner booking failures, third-party service issues, or indirect losses resulting from travel arrangements.

GoVeTrip participates in affiliate marketing programs, including Travelpayouts, Booking.com, and rental car partners. We may earn a commission when a user clicks a referral link and completes a qualifying booking.

This does not increase the cost of travel for the user. Instead, the partner may compensate us for customer referrals. We use this revenue to sustain the platform, improve functionality, and continue providing comparisons and recommendations.
Affiliate links may use special identifiers or tracking URLs. These links help us attribute bookings to the appropriate partner source.
The disclosure statement displayed on the site is: We may earn a commission when you book through our links.
